description.en: Cuts context cost in DSH: a token-capped index of recent artifacts and touched paths keeps pointers after compaction, and a preset tuner moves the automatic compaction trigger earlier without freezing the preset (the override is regenerated from the shipped preset in app.asar). Adds a Settings page for the trigger, the retained amount, preview, and removal.
description.zh: 降低 DSH 的上下文成本：一份有 token 上限的索引保留最近产物与触碰过的路径，压缩后仍不丢指针；preset 调优器把自动压缩触发点提前，同时不冻结预设（覆盖由 app.asar 里的上游预设重新生成）。附带 Settings 面板，可调触发点与保留量、预览与移除。
